subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Solve problems in context
source.subtopic: Solve problems in context and explain own solutions involving addition and subtraction, repeated addition (weeks 3-10), and equal sharing and grouping that may include remainders

show.line: Two bikes. Each bike has two wheels. Two plus two equals four wheels. Adding the same number again!

rounds.prompt: Three plates. Two apples on each plate. How many apples?
rounds.praise: Six! Two plus two plus two.

rounds.story: Two children each have five fingers up. How many fingers altogether?
rounds.praise: Ten! Five plus five equals ten.

rounds.prompt: Four dogs. Each dog has two ears. Count the ears.
rounds.praise: Eight ears! Two, four, six, eight.

rounds.prompt: Three bags. Three sweets in each bag. How many sweets? Say the number.

rounds.story: Thandi shares eight cookies between two friends. Each gets the same. How many each?
rounds.praise: Four each! Four plus four is eight.

rounds.prompt: Two plus two plus two. Tap the answer.

hints: Count in jumps. Two, four, six.
Each group has the same number. Add them one group at a time.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Three bikes, two wheels each.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Two plus two plus two. Five wheels!
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Two, four, six. Six wheels.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count in twos together. Two, four, six wheels!

parent_line: Can add the same number again and again to solve a story sum.
